name: google-ads
description: Create, edit, and report on Google Ads from an AI agent through the AdKit MCP connector: Search and Performance Max campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, negative keywords, keyword research, search terms, and results. Every change is saved as a draft that the user approves before it goes live. Use when the user wants to run, change, or check Google Ads. Not for Google Ads strategy: use google-ads-strategy for that.
